title: Software Engineer (SDE)
whoItSuits: Students who enjoy building products, debugging logic, and continuous learning across frontend, backend, or full-stack systems.
entrySteps: Master one language (JS/TS, Python, or Java) and build 2 deployed full-stack or backend projects.
Solve 120–150 curated DSA problems (Arrays, Maps, Trees, Graphs) with clean time/space explanations.
Apply for internships via Wellfound, LinkedIn, and campus placements before final-year graduation.

steps.label: Pick one primary language (JavaScript, Python, or Java) and master syntax & OOP
Learn Git, GitHub branching, and Linux/terminal basics
Build 3 small CLI or static web projects without tutorials
Practice Arrays, Strings, HashMaps, Two Pointers, and Recursion (80 problems)
Learn SQL (PostgreSQL) and build a REST API with authentication
Build and deploy 1 complete full-stack project with error handling
Cover Trees, Graphs, and basic Dynamic Programming (60 problems)
Write a 1-page ATS-friendly resume highlighting deployed project metrics
Do 5 mock technical + behavioral interviews and apply to 30+ targeted roles

title: Data Analyst
whoItSuits: Graduates from B.Tech, B.Com, B.Sc, or BBA who like spotting patterns in numbers and translating them into business decisions.
entrySteps: Become fluent in SQL queries and Excel pivot tables.
Build 2 India-contextual dashboards in Power BI (e.g., UPI transactions, quick-commerce retention).
Target GCCs, fintech, e-commerce, and analytics consultancies (Mu Sigma, Fractal, Tiger Analytics).

steps.label: Master Excel formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Pivot Tables, data cleaning)
Learn SQL SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, CTEs, and Window Functions
Solve 50 SQL business case queries on LeetCode / StrataScratch
Build 2 interactive Power BI dashboards with DAX measures
Learn Python Pandas for CSV cleaning and exploratory data analysis
Learn basic statistics: mean/median, A/B testing, correlation vs causation
Publish 2 case studies with clear business recommendations on GitHub/Notion
Practice SQL live-coding and 'guesstimate' case questions

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
whoItSuits: Engineering/CS/Math students comfortable with Python, linear algebra, probability, and shipping ML/LLM pipelines into production.
entrySteps: Build strong Python + classical ML fundamentals before jumping straight to LLMs.
Ship an end-to-end project with an evaluation benchmark (e.g., RAG with retrieval metrics).
Contribute to open-source or publish reproducible notebooks on Hugging Face / GitHub.

steps.label: Refresh Linear Algebra, Calculus gradients, and Probability distributions
Master NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn (regression, trees, clustering)
Implement cross-validation and proper train/val/test hygiene
Learn PyTorch tensors, autograd, and fine-tuning a small transformer
Build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) app with vector search & evals
Wrap your model/pipeline in FastAPI + Docker and deploy a live demo
Prepare ML system design and debugging case studies

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
whoItSuits: Structured thinkers who enjoy user empathy, prioritizing trade-offs, writing crisp specs, and working across engineering and design.
entrySteps: Write 3 product teardowns of Indian apps (e.g., Zepto, CRED, PhonePe, Zerodha).
Apply to APM programs (Flipkart, Razorpay, Swiggy, Zomato, Atlassian) or transition internally from QA/Dev/Analytics.
Build a small no-code or AI-assisted side product to show execution.

steps.label: Read foundational product case studies and learn user journey mapping
Write 3 structured Product Teardowns (problem, metrics, trade-offs)
Learn SQL basics and North Star / retention cohort metrics
Draft a complete PRD with Figma/wireframe sketches for a real feature
Practice 15 product design, root-cause analysis (RCA), and guesstimate mocks
Ship a micro-product or campus initiative and document outcomes

title: UI / UX Designer
whoItSuits: Visual and empathetic problem-solvers who care about typography, usability, accessibility, and clean user flows.
entrySteps: Master Figma auto-layout and component variants.
Publish 2–3 deep UX case studies showing problem discovery, iterations, and before/after usability—not just pretty Dribbble shots.
Seek internships at design studios or early-stage SaaS startups.

steps.label: Learn typography, spacing grids, contrast accessibility, and color systems
Master Figma components, auto-layout, and interactive prototyping
Conduct 5 user interviews and map pain points for an everyday Indian app
Write 2 end-to-end UX case studies on Notion/Behance with clear rationale
Practice whiteboard design challenges and portfolio walkthroughs
Apply to product startups and agencies with tailored Loom walkthroughs

title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
whoItSuits: Engineers who enjoy Linux, networking, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and keeping production systems reliable.
entrySteps: Get comfortable with Linux shell, DNS, HTTP, and SSH.
Containerize a multi-service app with Docker, deploy it on AWS/GCP free tier via Terraform + GitHub Actions.
Earn AWS Solutions Architect Associate or CKA (optional, pairs well with labs).

steps.label: Master Linux permissions, systemd, processes, and bash scripting
Understand TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/HTTPS, reverse proxies (Nginx)
Containerize a web app + database using Docker and Docker Compose
Deploy on AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS) and automate with Terraform
Build a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with automated tests
Learn Kubernetes pods, services, deployments, and Prometheus/Grafana basics

title: Cybersecurity Analyst (SOC / AppSec)
whoItSuits: Detail-oriented learners fascinated by how networks and web apps break—and how to defend them.
entrySteps: Complete foundational rooms on TryHackMe or Hack The Box (Blue Team / Web).
Document vulnerability write-ups and home-lab SIEM setups on GitHub.
Target SOC Analyst L1 roles or Junior AppSec internships.

steps.label: Master networking ports, protocols, and packet analysis with Wireshark
Learn Linux administration and Windows Event Logs
Practice OWASP Top 10 labs (SQLi, XSS, IDOR) using PortSwigger Academy
Set up a home SIEM lab (Wazuh or Splunk) and write detection rules
Prepare for CompTIA Security+ or eJPT / BTL1 (optional)
Publish 5 clean lab write-ups and apply to MSSPs and GCC SOC teams

title: Chartered Accountant / Corporate Finance
whoItSuits: Commerce and finance students with strong numerical discipline aiming for audit, taxation, FP&A, or investment banking.
entrySteps: Clear CA Foundation/Inter or pair B.Com with NISM/CFA Level 1 for non-CA finance roles.
Build a 3-statement financial model and DCF valuation in Excel for a listed Indian company.
Target Big 4 articleship/analyst roles or corporate FP&A teams.

steps.label: Master balance sheet, P&L, and cash flow statement linkages
Build keyboard-only Excel fluency and financial formulas
Build a 3-statement model + DCF for an NSE-listed company
Complete Articleship / finance internship with real client exposure
Choose track: Statutory Audit, M&A/Valuation, FP&A, or Tax Advisory
Prepare technical finance + current Indian market case interviews

title: Management / Strategy Consultant
whoItSuits: Analytical communicators who enjoy solving ambiguous business problems across industries.
entrySteps: Practice 30+ consulting case interviews (profitability, market entry) with peers.
Build clean, insight-led slide decks summarizing an Indian industry sector.
Apply to MBB, Big 4 Strategy, Kearney, Alvarez & Marsal, or boutique firms.

steps.label: Learn MECE structuring, profitability trees, and market entry frameworks
Solve 25 India-centric guesstimates out loud
Practice rapid mental math and unit economics calculations
Create 2 crisp 5-slide strategy decks on Indian retail or EV sectors
Complete 20 live peer mock cases with feedback logs
Refine PEI / leadership stories using the STAR format

title: Digital Marketing & Growth
whoItSuits: Creative yet metrics-driven graduates who like copywriting, consumer psychology, performance ads, and SEO.
entrySteps: Run a live micro-project (blog, Instagram page, or ₹2,000 test ad campaign) to show real metrics.
Learn GA4, Search Console, and basic Excel/Looker Studio reporting.
Apply to D2C brands, SaaS startups, or performance marketing agencies.

steps.label: Learn customer funnels (CAC, LTV, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate)
Master on-page/technical SEO and Google Search Console
Learn Meta Ads Manager & Google Search Ads campaign structure
Set up GA4 event tracking on a personal site or demo store
Write a 2-page growth audit for an Indian D2C brand and pitch it
Build a portfolio of ad copy, landing page teardowns, and campaign results

title: Biotech & Clinical Research
whoItSuits: B.Sc / M.Sc / B.Pharm / B.Tech Biotech graduates interested in clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, or bioinformatics.
entrySteps: Master ICH-GCP principles and clinical trial phases (Phase I–IV).
Learn basic biostatistics and clinical data tools (SAS/R or EDC systems).
Target CROs (IQVIA, Parexel, Syneos, ICON) and pharma hubs (Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune).

steps.label: Study ICH-GCP guidelines, IRB/IEC ethics, and Clinical Trial Phases I–IV
Understand Pharmacovigilance (ICSR, MedDRA) and Regulatory Affairs
Learn Clinical Data Management (CRF design, query resolution)
Learn introductory SAS or R for clinical trial summary tables
Prepare for CRC / Junior CRA / PV Associate interviews
Apply to CROs and hospital clinical research departments

title: EV & Embedded Systems Engineer
whoItSuits: ECE, EEE, and Mechanical/Mechatronics students who want to work on hardware, firmware, BMS, or India's growing EV ecosystem.
entrySteps: Build real firmware projects on STM32 or ESP32 using bare-metal C (not just Arduino delays).
Understand CAN protocol and motor control / BMS fundamentals for EV roles.
Target EV OEMs (Ather, Ola Electric, TVS, Tata Elxsi) and semiconductor GCCs.

steps.label: Master pointers, bit manipulation, interrupts, and timers in Embedded C
Implement UART, I2C, and SPI drivers on STM32 or ESP32
Build a multi-tasking firmware project using FreeRTOS
Study CAN Bus protocol and Li-ion Battery Management System (BMS) basics
Design a 2-layer PCB in KiCad and document oscilloscope testing
Practice C memory layout, volatile/static, and peripheral debugging Q&A

title: Civil Services & Public Policy (UPSC / State PSC)
salaryBand: Pay Level 10+ (₹56,100 basic + allowances) · Policy: ₹6 – ₹14 LPA
whoItSuits: Graduates committed to public administration, governance, and policy—with a disciplined multi-month study habit and a clear Plan B.
entrySteps: Read NCERTs (Class 6–12) and standard reference texts before chasing coaching notes.
Set a strict 1–2 attempt time-box and keep a parallel policy/analytics skill warm.
Explore public policy fellowships (LAMP, Gandhi Fellowship, State CM Fellowships) as strong parallel options.

steps.label: Analyze the last 5 years of Prelims & Mains Previous Year Questions (PYQs)
Complete foundational NCERTs and 1 standard book per GS subject
Complete Optional Subject Paper 1 & 2 with concise revision notes
Write 2 timed Mains answers daily and review structure
Solve 30+ full-length Prelims & CSAT mock tests with error logs
Apply to parallel public policy fellowships or research roles

title: GATE (M.Tech / PSU Track)
whoItSuits: Engineering students aiming for IIT/IISc M.Tech/MS research or stable core engineering roles in Maharatna PSUs.
entrySteps: Target 70+ marks by focusing deeply on high-weightage core subjects + Engineering Math + Aptitude.
Solve the last 15 years of GATE PYQs topic-by-topic.
Keep placement skills lightly active so you have options regardless of rank.

steps.label: Master Engineering Mathematics and General Aptitude (28% of paper)
Complete top 4 highest-weightage core subjects with short formula notes
Finish remaining core syllabus and solve 15 years of GATE PYQs
Maintain an error notebook for silly mistakes and conceptual gaps
Take 20+ full 3-hour CBT mock tests using the virtual GATE calculator
Shortlist COAP / CCMT M.Tech programs and PSU notifications
